requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: Every machinery installation and associated equipment shall have protection coverage for applicable ice accretion, snow accumulation, seawater ice ingestion, liquid freezing or viscosity increase, seawater intake temperature, and snow ingestion hazards.
requirement.requiredInputs: Machinery inventory, hazard applicability, and protection evidence
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Machinery installations and associated equipment shall be protected against the effect of ice accretion and/or snow accumulation, ice ingestion from sea water, freezing and increased viscosity of liquids, seawater intake temperature and snow ingestion.
